facts.fact: The Konza Technopolis Development Authority, a state agency under the Ministry of Information, Communications and the Digital Economy, says it is operationalising a National Data Center offering services to government and private enterprises, in a call for partners opened 8 July 2025.
The Konza Data Center is run by the Konza Technopolis Development Authority, a Kenyan state agency, per its own call for partners of 8 July 2025.
The Authority describes the Konza National Data Center as Tier III certified, in its call for partners opened 8 July 2025.
